title: Fees Carried by a Rural Home Loans Replacement Remittance
content:
**Guidance clause.** The fees a Rural Home Loans replacement remittance carries depend on the return it replaces, and the fees carried are part of the replacement remittance, added to its principal-and-interest and escrow shares.

## Clause

The fees the replacement carries depend on the return it replaces: when the return reason is not unauthorized and another remittance on the loan was returned in the twelve months up to today, the replacement carries every fee unpaid on the loan, so a repeat return clears the account; when the return reason is not unauthorized and no other remittance was returned in those twelve months, it carries only the fees assessed on the loan in the month up to today, the charges this return caused, as far as they are unpaid; when the return reason is unauthorized, the member disputes the debit and the replacement carries no fee.

## Terms

- **The return it replaces:** the most recent returned remittance on the loan, with the return reason on its principal payment return entry.
- **Another remittance returned in the twelve months up to today:** a principal payment return entry on the loan, other than that one, dated from the day after the same calendar day twelve months before today through today.
- **Every fee unpaid on the loan:** the unpaid fees on the loan record.
- **Fees assessed in the month up to today, as far as unpaid:** the fee assessments on the loan dated from the day after the same calendar day one month before today through today, added together, and no more than the unpaid fees on the loan record.

## Branches

| Return reason | Another return in the twelve months | Fees carried |
|---|---|---|
| not unauthorized | yes | every fee unpaid on the loan |
| not unauthorized | no | the fees assessed in the month up to today, no more than the unpaid fees |
| unauthorized | either | none |

## Worked case (hypothetical ledger)

The loan shows unpaid fees of 113.00: a 30.00 fee from five months ago and, in the past month, a late charge of 48.00 and a returned-payment fee of 35.00. With no other return in the twelve months, the fees carried are 83.00; with another return in the twelve months, they are 113.00.
